mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days across all monetary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 720,000 million dollars indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 1400.0 and RSAFS < 720000, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually), a federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 thousand units signals residential construction weakness that precedes consumer spending slowdowns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic growth regimes (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 720,000 million dollars signals consumer demand deceleration that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.5% and RSAFS < 720000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
